# Download metadata
```{r load-gene-constraint-metadata}

# isn't an AnVIL workspace, which is why avworkspace_namespace() fails in the next chunk)

  read_delim("ref/genemap2.txt", delim="\t", skip=3)

  filter(granularity == "percentile")

loeuf_df <- read_delim("ref/gnomad.v4.1.1.constraint_metrics.tsv.bgz") %>%
  filter(mane_select) %>%
  filter(startsWith(gene_id, "ENSG")) %>%
  select(gene_name=gene, gene_id_simple=gene_id, LOEUF=lof.oe_ci.upper) %>%
  mutate(
    LOEUF_perc = findInterval(LOEUF, loeuf_percs$threshold)
  )
```

# Download MEI data
```{r download-mei-bed-files}
# Get the BED File with SVA genotypes
sva_bed_df <- gs_download("scratch/yulia/l1meaid_intactmei_annotations.bcftoolsmerge.wholegenome.phaseII.FILTERED.ori_intact_anno.SVA.clustered.bed") %>%
  read_delim(col_names=c("chrom", "start", "end", "REF", "ALT", "ID", "MEI_type", "MEI_subfamily", "length", "orientation", "intact_status", "cluster_id")) %>%
  mutate(sva_id = paste0("SVA_MEI_cl", sprintf("%05d", cluster_id)))  %>%
  mutate(ALT_md5 = sapply(ALT, digest, algo="md5", serialize=FALSE))

alu_bed_df <- gs_download("scratch/yulia/l1meaid_intactmei_annotations.bcftoolsmerge.wholegenome.phaseII.FILTERED.ori_intact_anno.ALU.clustered.bed") %>%
  read_delim(col_names=c("chrom", "start", "end", "REF", "ALT", "ID", "MEI_type", "MEI_subfamily", "length", "orientation", "intact_status", "cluster_id") ) %>%
  mutate(var_id = paste0("Alu_MEI_cl", sprintf("%05d", cluster_id)))  %>%
  mutate(ALT_md5 = sapply(ALT, digest, algo="md5", serialize=FALSE))

line1_bed_df <- gs_download("scratch/yulia/l1meaid_intactmei_annotations.bcftoolsmerge.wholegenome.phaseII.FILTERED.ori_intact_anno.LINE.clustered.bed") %>%
  read_delim(col_names=c("chrom", "start", "end", "REF", "ALT", "ID", "MEI_type", "MEI_subfamily", "length", "orientation", "intact_status", "cluster_id"))   %>%
  mutate(var_id = paste0("LINE1_MEI_cl", sprintf("%05d", cluster_id)))  %>%
  mutate(ALT_md5 = sapply(ALT, digest, algo="md5", serialize=FALSE))

sva_bed_df %>% head()

View(sva_bed_df)

```

```{r build-sva-fasta}
# Get Fasta File
sva_bed_df <- sva_bed_df %>% 
  mutate(final_DNA = if_else(orientation == "-", as.character(reverseComplement(DNAStringSet(ALT))), ALT)) %>%
  mutate(id_n = 1:n()) %>%
  mutate(sva_id = paste0("SVA_MEI_cl", sprintf("%05d", cluster_id))) %>%
  mutate(fastaheader=glue("{chrom}:{start}-{end}:{ALT_md5}")) 
  

nrow(sva_bed_df)
sva_bed_df %>% select(chrom, start, end, ID, cluster_id, ALT) %>% distinct() %>% nrow()

sva_bed_df %>%
  filter(orientation != "NONE") %>%
  mutate(fastaentry=glue(">{fastaheader}\n{final_DNA}")) %>%
  pull(fastaentry) %>%
  writeLines("mei_sva_clustered_seqs.fasta")
gs_upload("mei_sva_clustered_seqs.fasta", "scratch/alex/sva_seqs")

top5_uniq_clusters <- sva_bed_df %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  tally(sort=TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n=5) %>%
  pull(cluster_id)

top100_uniq_clusters <- sva_bed_df %>% 
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  tally(sort=TRUE) %>%
  slice_head(n=100) %>%
  pull(cluster_id)

sva_bed_df %>%
  filter(cluster_id %in% top5_uniq_clusters) %>%
  mutate(fastaentry=glue(">{fastaheader}\n{final_DNA}")) %>%
  pull(fastaentry) %>%
  writeLines("mei_sva_clustered_seqs_top5variable.fasta")
#gs_upload("mei_sva_clustered_seqs_top5variable.fasta", "scratch/alex/sva_seqs")

sva_bed_df %>%
  filter(cluster_id %in% top_uniq_clusters) %>%
  mutate(fastaentry=glue(">{fastaheader}\n{final_DNA}")) %>%
  pull(fastaentry) %>%
  writeLines("mei_sva_clustered_seqs_topvariable.fasta")
gs_upload("mei_sva_clustered_seqs_topvariable.fasta", "scratch/alex/sva_seqs")

#gs_upload("mei_sva_clustered_seqs.fasta", "scratch/alex/sva_seqs")

```

```{r write-sva-regions-bed}
sva_bed_df %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  summarize(chrom = unique(chrom), start = min(start), end=max(end)) %>%
  select(chrom, start, end, cluster_id) %>%
  arrange(chrom, start) %>%
  write_delim("mei_svas.bed", col_names=FALSE, delim="\t")
```

# Classify SVA MEIs by gencode region
## Download gencode file
```{bash parse-gencode-gtf}
# TODO: ~/programs/bedtools is a hardcoded path from the old machine — confirm it (and
# ref/gencode.v48.basic.annotation.gtf.gz, ref/hg38.chrom.sizes used a couple chunks down)
# actually exist here. Bash chunks don't stop the notebook on a missing-file error, so a
# failure here just shows up later as missing files in "annotate-sva-positions"
gtf="ref/gencode.v48.basic.annotation.gtf.gz"

zcat ref/gencode.v48.basic.annotation.gtf.gz \
  | awk '$3=="gene" {
      id=$0;   sub(/.*gene_id "/,   "", id);   sub(/".*/, "", id)
      name=$0; sub(/.*gene_name "/, "", name); sub(/".*/, "", name)
      type=$0; sub(/.*gene_type "/, "", type); sub(/".*/, "", type)
      print id, name, type
    }' OFS="\t" > ref/gene_info.tsv
    
# genes
zcat $gtf | awk '$3=="gene"' > ref/genes.gtf

# exons
zcat $gtf | awk '$3=="CDS" || $3=="UTR" || $3=="start_codon" || $3=="stop_codon"' > ref/exon_features.gtf

zcat $gtf | awk '$3=="exon"' > ref/exons.gtf

# introns = gene bodies minus exons
bedtools subtract \
  -a ref/genes.gtf \
  -b ref/exons.gtf \
  > ref/introns.gtf
  
zcat $gtf | awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} $3=="gene" {
  id=$0; sub(/.*gene_id "/, "", id); sub(/".*/, "", id)
  print $1, $4-1, $5, id, ".", $7
}' > ref/genes.bed

#zcat $gtf | awk 'BEGIN{OFS="\t"} $3=="gene" {
#  print $1, $4-1, $5, ".", ".", $7
#}'  > ref/genes.bed

# genome sizes required
# e.g. hg38.chrom.sizes

```

```{bash make-flanking-regions}
# 10kb upstream, strand-aware
bedtools flank -s -l 10000 -r 0 \
  -i ref/genes.bed \
  -g ref/hg38.chrom.sizes \
  > ref/upstream_10kb.bed

# 10kb downstream, strand-aware
bedtools flank -s -l 0 -r 10000 \
  -i ref/genes.bed \
  -g ref/hg38.chrom.sizes \
  > ref/downstream_10kb.bed
```

## Now do the intersections
```{bash build-ref-sva-bed}
# TODO: SVA_regions_van_bree_flanked.txt doesn't exist in the cwd on this VM — needs to be
# copied over (or this path fixed) before this runs
cut -f 1,5 SVA_regions_van_bree_flanked.txt | tr ":" "\t" | tr "-" "\t" | sort -k1,1 -k2,2n > ref_svas.bed
```

```{bash intersect-genic-regions}
# GTF intersections: extract gene_id from attribute string
extract_gene_gtf='BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {
  id=$0; sub(/.*gene_id "/, "", id); sub(/".*/, "", id)
  print $1,$2,$3,$4,id
}'
extract_gene_gtf_wfeature='BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {
  id=$0; sub(/.*gene_id "/, "", id); sub(/".*/, "", id)
  print $1,$2,$3,$4,id,$7
}' 

# BED intersections: gene_id is col4 of upstream/downstream BED → col7 after -wa -wb
extract_gene_bed='BEGIN{OFS="\t"} {print $1,$2,$3,$4,$8}'

bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a mei_svas.bed -b ref/exon_features.gtf   | awk "$extract_gene_gtf_wfeature" > intersect/mei_sva.exonic_feature.bed
bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a mei_svas.bed -b ref/exons.gtf           | awk "$extract_gene_gtf" > intersect/mei_sva.exonic.bed
bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a mei_svas.bed -b ref/introns.gtf         | awk "$extract_gene_gtf" > intersect/mei_sva.intronic.bed
bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a mei_svas.bed -b ref/upstream_10kb.bed   | awk "$extract_gene_bed" > intersect/mei_sva.upstream.bed
bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a mei_svas.bed -b ref/downstream_10kb.bed | awk "$extract_gene_bed" > intersect/mei_sva.downstream.bed

bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a ref_svas.bed -b ref/exon_features.gtf   | awk "$extract_gene_gtf_wfeature" > intersect/ref_sva.exonic_feature.bed
bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a ref_svas.bed -b ref/exons.gtf           | awk "$extract_gene_gtf" > intersect/ref_sva.exonic.bed
bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a ref_svas.bed -b ref/introns.gtf         | awk "$extract_gene_gtf" > intersect/ref_sva.intronic.bed
bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a ref_svas.bed -b ref/upstream_10kb.bed   | awk "$extract_gene_bed" > intersect/ref_sva.upstream.bed
bedtools intersect -wa -wb -a ref_svas.bed -b ref/downstream_10kb.bed | awk "$extract_gene_bed" > intersect/ref_sva.downstream.bed

```

## Generate the full annotation
```{r annotate-sva-positions}
gene_metadata <- read_delim("ref/gene_info.tsv", col_names = c("gene_id", "gene_name", "gene_type"))

col_names_int <- c("chrom", "start", "end", "cluster_id", "gene_id")
annot_levels <- c("CDS", "UTR", "exon", "intron", "upstream", "downstream", "intergenic")

# First for MEIs
mei_sva_exonic_feature <- read_delim("intersect/mei_sva.exonic_feature.bed", col_names = c(col_names_int, "annot"))
mei_sva_exonic <- read_delim("intersect/mei_sva.exonic.bed", col_names = col_names_int)
mei_sva_intronic <- read_delim("intersect/mei_sva.intronic.bed", col_names = col_names_int)
mei_sva_upstream <- read_delim("intersect/mei_sva.upstream.bed", col_names = col_names_int)
mei_sva_downstream <- read_delim("intersect/mei_sva.downstream.bed", col_names = col_names_int) 

mei_sva_pos_bygene <- bind_rows(
  mei_sva_exonic_feature,
  mei_sva_exonic %>% mutate(annot = "exon"),
  mei_sva_intronic %>% mutate(annot = "intron"),
  mei_sva_upstream %>% mutate(annot = "upstream"),
  mei_sva_downstream %>% mutate(annot = "downstream")
) %>%
  select(cluster_id, gene_id, annot) %>%
  mutate(annot = factor(annot, levels=annot_levels, ordered=TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id, gene_id) %>%
  summarize(annot = min(annot)) %>%
  mutate(sva_id = paste0("SVA_MEI_cl", sprintf("%05d", cluster_id)))  %>%
  left_join(gene_metadata)

mei_sva_pos_overall <- sva_bed_df %>% select(cluster_id) %>% distinct() %>% left_join(mei_sva_pos_bygene %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>% 
  filter(annot == min(annot))
) %>%
  mutate(annot = replace_na(annot, "intergenic")) %>%
  mutate(sva_id = paste0("SVA_MEI_cl", sprintf("%05d", cluster_id))) 

mei_sva_pos_overall_pc <- sva_bed_df %>% select(cluster_id) %>% distinct() %>% left_join(mei_sva_pos_bygene %>%
  filter(gene_type == "protein_coding") %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>% 
  filter(annot == min(annot))
) %>%
  mutate(annot = replace_na(annot, "intergenic")) %>%
  mutate(sva_id = paste0("SVA_MEI_cl", sprintf("%05d", cluster_id))) 

# Now for REFs
ref_sva_exonic_feature <- read_delim("intersect/ref_sva.exonic_feature.bed", col_names = c(col_names_int, "annot"))
ref_sva_exonic <- read_delim("intersect/ref_sva.exonic.bed", col_names = col_names_int)
ref_sva_intronic <- read_delim("intersect/ref_sva.intronic.bed", col_names = col_names_int)
ref_sva_upstream <- read_delim("intersect/ref_sva.upstream.bed", col_names = col_names_int)
ref_sva_downstream <- read_delim("intersect/ref_sva.downstream.bed", col_names = col_names_int) 

ref_sva_pos_bygene <- bind_rows(
  ref_sva_exonic_feature,
  ref_sva_exonic %>% mutate(annot = "exon"),
  ref_sva_intronic %>% mutate(annot = "intron"),
  ref_sva_upstream %>% mutate(annot = "upstream"),
  ref_sva_downstream %>% mutate(annot = "downstream")
) %>%
  select(sva_id, gene_id, annot) %>%
  mutate(annot = factor(annot, levels=annot_levels, ordered=TRUE)) %>%
  group_by(sva_id, gene_id) %>%
  summarize(annot = min(annot)) %>%
  left_join(gene_metadata)

# TODO: ref_subfamily is used here but isn't defined until the "mei-subfamily-by-element"
# chunk further down — this chunk currently depends on something defined later in the doc
ref_sva_pos_overall <- ref_subfamily %>% select(sva_id) %>% distinct() %>% left_join(ref_sva_pos_bygene %>%
  group_by(sva_id) %>% 
  filter(annot == min(annot))
) %>%
  mutate(annot = replace_na(annot, "intergenic"))

ref_sva_pos_overall_pc <- ref_subfamily %>% select(sva_id) %>% distinct() %>% left_join(ref_sva_pos_bygene %>%
  filter(gene_type == "protein_coding") %>%
  group_by(sva_id) %>% 
  filter(annot == min(annot))
) %>%
  mutate(annot = replace_na(annot, "intergenic"))
```

## Now look at variability

### First by subfamily
```{r mei-subfamily-by-element}
mei_subfamily_groups <- sva_bed_df %>%
  group_by(chrom, cluster_id, MEI_subfamily) %>%
  tally() 

ambig_subfamily <- mei_subfamily_groups %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  filter(max(frac) <= 0.5) %>%
  pull(cluster_id) %>%
  unique()
  
mei_subfamily <- mei_subfamily_groups %>%
  filter(!(cluster_id %in% ambig_subfamily)) %>%
  group_by(cluster_id) %>%
  filter(n == max(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(sva_id = paste0("SVA_MEI_cl", sprintf("%05d", cluster_id))) %>%
  select(sva_id, subfamily=MEI_subfamily)

ref_subfamily <- read_delim("SVA_regions_van_bree_flanked.txt", col_names=c("region", "subfamily", "strand", "score", "SVA_id")) %>%
  select(sva_id=SVA_id, subfamily)

  
set.seed(100)
mei_length_tidy %>%
  left_join(mei_subfamily) %>%
  filter(!is.na(subfamily)) %>%
  ggplot(aes(x=length_hexamer, y=subfamily)) +
  geom_boxplot(color="black", scale="width", outlier.size=0.5, outlier.color="grey", outlier.alpha=0.5) +
  #geom_jitter(alpha=0.5, color='grey') + 
  scale_y_discrete(limits=rev) +
  labs(x = "Hexamer Length") +
  theme_clean(base_size=20) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
  )
ggsave("figures/MEI_hex_length_by_subfamily.pdf", width=5, height=3)
```

### Now within individual elements
```{r element-level-variability}
mei_element_sds <- mei_length_tidy %>%
  group_by(sva_id) %>%
  filter(n() > 0.001 * 2 * 10000) %>%
  summarize(hexamer_sd = sd(length_hexamer, na.rm=TRUE), vntr_sd = sd(length_VNTR, na.rm=TRUE))

mei_mean_hex_variable <- mean(mei_element_sds$hexamer_sd >= 6)
mei_mean_vntr_variable <- mean(mei_element_sds$vntr_sd >= 18)

ref_element_sds <- ref_length_tidy %>%
  group_by(sva_id) %>%
  summarize(hexamer_sd = sd(length_hexamer, na.rm=TRUE), vntr_sd = sd(length_VNTR, na.rm=TRUE))

ref_mean_hex_variable <- mean(ref_element_sds$hexamer_sd >= 6)
ref_mean_vntr_variable <- mean(ref_element_sds$vntr_sd >= 18)

mei_element_sds %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hexamer_sd, y = vntr_sd)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(x="SD(Hexamer Length)", y="SD(VNTR Length)") +
    theme_clean(base_size=20)
ggsave("figures/MEI_VNTRvsHex_variability.pdf", width=3, height=3)

ref_element_sds %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = hexamer_sd, y = vntr_sd)) +
    geom_point() +
    labs(x="SD(Hexamer Length)", y="SD(VNTR Length)") +
    theme_clean(base_size=20)
ggsave("figures/REF_VNTRvsHex_variability.pdf", width=3, height=3)

```

# Make waterfall plots
```{r waterfall-plots}

repeat_positions <- read_delim("./mei_sva_clustered_seqs.fasta_repeat_positions.txt") %>%
  dplyr::rename(seq_name="ID") %>%
  left_join(sva_bed_df %>% select(ID, cluster_id, MEI_subfamily, fastaheader), by=c("seq_name"="fastaheader"))

graph_cluster1 <- 1328
graph_cluster2 <- 10610
graph_cluster3 <- 2564

graph_svas <- function(df, base_size) {
  df %>%
    filter(!(region %in% c("hexamer_region", "VNTR_region"))) %>%
    mutate(region = if_else(grepl("skip", region, fixed=TRUE), "skip", region)) %>%
    group_by(ID) %>%
    mutate(total_length = max(end)) %>%
    mutate(mid = (start+end)/2, length = (end - start)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(y=reorder(seq_name, -total_length))) +
    geom_tile(aes(x=mid, fill=region, width=length), height=0.95) +
    scale_x_continuous(expand=c(0,0)) +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values=c("hex"='red', "VNTR_1"="#92cbdf", "VNTR_2"="#2596be", "VNTR_3"="#134b5f", "skip"='grey')
    ) + 
    labs(x = 'Position', y = 'Haplotype', fill = 'Repeat type') +
    theme_clean(base_size=base_size) +
    theme(
      panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
      axis.text.y = element_blank()
    )
}

for (i in 1:10) {

    filter(cluster_id == top100_uniq_clusters[i]) %>%
    #mutate(region = if_else(region == "hex", "skip", region)) %>%
    graph_svas()
}

sample_frac_of_column <- function(df, column, frac=0.1) {
  values <- df[[column]] %>% unique()
  s_values <- sample(values, ceiling(frac * length(values)))
  df %>%
    filter(.data[[column]] %in% s_values)
}

set.seed(101)
repeat_positions %>%
  filter(cluster_id == graph_cluster1) %>%
  sample_frac_of_column("seq_name", frac=0.1) %>%
  mutate(region = if_else(region == "hex", "skip", region)) %>%
  graph_svas(base_size=20) + 
  labs(y="chr10:3041557_INS Haplotype") 
ggsave(glue("figures/SVA_hap_examples_{graph_cluster1}.pdf"))
```

```{r local-ancestry}
             "CentralSouthAsia","CentralSouthAsia","CentralSouthAsia","CentralSouthAsia","CentralSouthAsia","Africa","Africa","Oceania","Europe","Oceania",
             "MiddleEast","MiddleEast","Europe","MiddleEast","Americas","EastAsia","EastAsia","EastAsia","Europe","Americas",
             "Americas","Europe","Africa","Africa","EastAsia","Africa","Africa","Americas","Americas","EastAsia",
             "Europe","Europe","EastAsia","EastAsia","EastAsia","EastAsia","EastAsia","EastAsia","EastAsia","MiddleEast",

get_local_ancestry <- function(chrom, pos) {
  range <- 100000
  start <- pos - range
  end <- pos + range
  # TODO: Change this to use gs URL
  url <- glue("~/la_vcfs/{chrom}.anc.vcf.gz")
  command = glue("~/programs/bcftools-1.23.1/bcftools query -r {chrom}:{start}-{end} -f '[%CHROM\t%POS\t%SAMPLE\t%AN1\t%AN2\n]' {url}  > filtered_regions/{chrom}_{pos}_la.txt")
  system(command)
  df <- read_delim(glue("filtered_regions/{chrom}_{pos}_la.txt"), col_names=c("chrom", "pos", "indiv", "h1_la", "h2_la"), show_col_types=FALSE)
  
  all_pos <- df$pos %>% unique()
  closest_pos_up <- max(all_pos[all_pos < pos])
  closest_pos_down <- min(all_pos[all_pos > pos])
  
  df %>% 
    filter(pos %in% c(closest_pos_up, closest_pos_down)) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(h1_la, h2_la), names_to="hap", values_to="la") %>%
    mutate(hap = sub("_la", "", hap)) %>%
    group_by(indiv, hap) %>%
    filter(n_distinct(la) == 1) %>%
    select(indiv, hap, la) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    mutate() %>%
    left_join(ancestry_lookup, by=c(la="index"))
}
```

## Look at ancestry specific expansions
```{r ancestry-specific-expansions}

ancestries <- ancestry_file %>%
  drop_na(pred_ancestry) %>%
  pull(pred_ancestry) %>%
  unique()

# TODO: left_join() here has no arguments, and there's no %>% before group_by() —
# looks like an incomplete edit
z <- gt_byhap %>%
  left_join(ancestry_file, by="indiv") %>%
  left_join()
  group_by(sva_id) %>%
  filter(n() >= 0.05 * 12680 * 2) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c(length_VNTR, length_hexamer), names_prefix="length_", names_to="repeat_type", values_to="length")

overall_var <- z %>% 
  drop_na(pred_ancestry) %>%
  group_by(sva_id, repeat_type) %>%
  summarize(mean = mean(length), sd = sd(length), nn_perc = quantile(length, 0.99), n=n(), .groups="drop")

var_notanc <- lapply(ancestries, function(a) {
  z %>% 
    drop_na(pred_ancestry) %>%
    filter(pred_ancestry != a) %>%
    group_by(sva_id, repeat_type) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(length), sd = sd(length), nn_perc = quantile(length, 0.99), n=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
    mutate(pred_ancestry = a)
}) %>%
  bind_rows()

ancestry_var <- z %>% 
  drop_na(pred_ancestry) %>%
  group_by(sva_id, repeat_type, pred_ancestry) %>%
  summarize(mean_anc = mean(length), sd_anc = sd(length),  n_anc=n(), .groups="drop") %>%
  left_join(overall_var) %>%
  left_join(
    var_notanc %>%
      select(sva_id, repeat_type, pred_ancestry, mean_notanc=mean, sd_notanc=sd, nn_perc_notanc=nn_perc, n_notanc=n)
  )

anc_z_scores <- z %>%
  inner_join(ancestry_var %>% filter(sd > 0)) %>%
  mutate(z_sc = ((length - mean) / sd), z_sc_notanc = ((length-mean_notanc)/sd_notanc))

anc_z_scores %>%
  filter((repeat_type == "hexamer" & mean > 20) | (repeat_type == "VNTR" & mean > 100)) %>%
  group_by(pred_ancestry) %>%
  tally()

anc_z_scores %>%
  filter((repeat_type == "hexamer" & mean > 20) | (repeat_type == "VNTR" & mean > 100)) %>%
  filter(abs(z_sc) > 6) %>%
  group_by(pred_ancestry) %>%
  tally()

anc_z_scores %>%
  filter((repeat_type == "hexamer" & mean > 20) | (repeat_type == "VNTR" & mean > 100)) %>%
  filter(length > nn_perc_notanc) %>%
```
